purpose: Targeted regression coverage for a clean but degraded inline G2 in a completed native run.

evals.prompt: A source-qualified Build End-to-End run performs clean brief-to-spec coverage inline because no native fresh checker is available. The controller stores CLEAN_DEGRADED_INLINE. Implementation, review, technical/security verification, Browser E2E, fresh external G4, design drift and documentation drift all pass.
evals.expected_outcome: The controller preserves CLEAN_DEGRADED_INLINE, reports DELIVERY_STATUS=COMPLETE when the applicable delivery gates are proven, derives RUN_RIGOR=DEGRADED with G2_INDEPENDENCE, and keeps the same distinction in finish/handoff and dashboard projections.
assertions: G4 PASS does not upgrade G2
dashboard and progress remain projections and cannot promote G2

evals.prompt: A source-qualified Build End-to-End run produces MISSING, HALF_COVERED, or UNSOURCED material brief coverage during G2.
evals.expected_outcome: The controller stores G2=GAP and blocks PLAN. Later implementation, G4, documentation or finish claims cannot bypass the missing specification coverage.
assertions: No post-hoc G2 upgrade bypasses the pre-PLAN block
